title: oparanthus albus
intro: Oparanthus albus, commonly known as White Top, is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is native to North America and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Oparanthus albus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation.
